text: Complete: ScalaFIM now has a typed radial/HRBF latent subsystem with checked kernels/specs, sparse NeuroSpace active-mask support, deterministic atom generation, partial decode by typed time/voxel selections, shared-basis encoder/archive integration, and fmrilatent-derived parity fixtures.
